== Biography ==
Ann was born about 1839. She was the daughter of [[Glasgow-2603|Robert Glasgow]] and [[Lamb-11245|Mary Lamb]]. She passed away in 1904.
== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-2603]] is assessed at 76% (probable). The held account assigns Ann (Glasgow) Hogg to Robert Glasgow and Mary Lamb in the Bombay/Turakina family. Ann’s 1839 Lancashire birth fits, but her cited 1920/10746 death number duplicates Mary Knox’s and contradicts her 1904 death.

Confidence concerns this recorded child and the selected father as identified by the held family evidence; maternity and the father’s upstream ancestry are separate.

Next useful test: Inspect the 1842 Bombay passenger family list and the child’s NZ death certificate parent fields.

Source basis already held: [https://www.bdmhistoricalrecords.dia.govt.nz/search/search?path=%2FqueryEntry.m%3Ftype%3Dmarriages NZ marriage registration 1859/2665 (https://www.bdmhistoricalrecords.dia.govt.nz/search/search?path=%2FqueryEntry.m%3Ftype%3Dmarriages)].
